# Methods

# Mice

All mouse lines were maintained on a mixed genetic background. LooptTle3 line was generated using homologous recombination in ES cells. ES cell injection and chimera generation was performed by the IRCM Transgenesis platform. For transient transgenic lineage tracing, the Hsp68-nLacZ Reporter allele was used. Tle3 null allele was generated by crossing LooptTle3 and CMVCre lines. Pgk-Cre, Mesp1Cre, Mef2cAHFCre, Wnt1Cre, Nkx2.5Cre and R26R lines were previously described elsewhere Ai et al., 2006;Cai et al., 2003;Danielian et al., 1998;Saga et al., 1999;Verzi et al., 2005;Zhang et al., 2013). All mouse lines were maintained on a mixed background. All animal procedures were performed according to the IRCM Animal Care Committee and the Canadian Council on Animal Care.

# Tamoxifen induction of Cre recombinase

For inducible Cre alleles (i.e. Mesp1Cre and Mef2cAHFCre), tamoxifen was dissolved in corn oil by sonication at a concentration of 20mg/ml. Tamoxifen was administrated by oral gavage (1mg) to pregnant females at the indicated time points.

# Immunofluorescence

E9.0 embryos were fixed overnight in 2% PFA at 4°C, and then dehydrated in sucrose gradients.

Embryos were embedded in OCT and cut on a cryostat at 10µm thickness. Immunofluorescence was carried out using standard procedures using the following antibodies: TLE3 (1:100, LifeSpan BioSciences), FOXF1 (1:200), ISL1 (1:100, DSHB), Troponin I (1:100, Santa Cruz), Hand1 (1:100, Santa Cruz), atrial myosin heavy chain (1:50, Abcam) and β myosin heavy chain (1:50, Abcam).

# Histology

For histological analysis, whole embryos (E14.5) or adult hearts were fixed overnight in 4% PFA at 4°C. Embryos and hearts were sectioned at 5µm thickness on a microtome, and sections were mounted and stained according to standard procedures.

# In situ hybridization

Whole mount in situ hybridization was performed according to standard procedures using the following probes: Tle3, Lefty2, Pitx2, myocardin (gift from E. Olson), Irx4 and Fgf8.

# Quantitative real-time PCR

Quantitative real-time PCR (RT-qPCR) was performed on the LpmC and LpmP of control and Wnt1Cre; LooptTle3 embryos. The LpmC and LpmP were microdissected from E9.0 embryos, and total RNA was extracted using the RNeasy® Micro Kit (Qiagen, cat.74004). All cDNA was produced using the QuantiTect® Reverse Transcription Kit (Qiagen, cat.205311). RT-qPCR was performed using an ABI7500 (Applied Biosystems) with Power SYBR® Green (Life Technologies). Gapdh expression was used as the internal control.

For experiments using the Hsp68-nLacZ reporter, hearts were microdissected and dissociated in 0.25% trypsin for 10 minutes at 37°C. Resulting cell suspensions were then equally divided and plated into 96 well plates coated with either fibronectin or matrigel. After 3 hours, whole wells were collected, and total RNA was extracted as mentioned above.

# Electroporations

Transgenic lineage tracing experiments were performed as previously described with a few modifications. Briefly, E8.0 embryos were dissected in sterile PBS and placed in a microelectroporator chamber containing Tyrode's solution. The pCAAGS-nLacZ and pCAGGS-Tle3-IRES-nGFP plasmids were injected into the pericardial cavity with a pressure injector. After 3 pulses of 10V, embryos were cultured in 50% rat serum / 50% Tyrode's solution for 24hrs in a rolling incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2, 95% air.

# Echocardiography

Echocardiography was performed on isoflurane-anesthetized animals using a Vevo660 ultrasound machine (Visualsonics, Toronto, Canada). Measurements of cardiac function were obtained from two-dimensional (short and long axis) images, and M-mode tracings. To evaluate the effect of exercise on heart function, animals were challenged with increasing concentrations of dobutamine (3, 6, 10 and 30µg/g/min), infused over a total period of 15 minutes via the jugular venous catheter inserted at the time of preliminary surgical preparation (typically, 3-4 days before experimental protocol).

# ECG recordings

To measure the functional consequences of structural heart anomalies, three-lead ECG recordings were obtained from anesthetized animals using subcutaneous needle electrodes connected to the temperature-controlled ECG amplifier (AD Instruments). Signal was digitized at the frequency of 10kHz (Powerlab 2/25, AD Instruments) and analyzed using LabChart software (ADInstruments).

# Statistical analysis

All statistical analysis was performed using PRISM software (GraphPad). All pairwise comparisons were made using the student's t-test. Data are presented as mean ± s.e.m., and differences were considered significant with p<0.05. # Methods

# Mice

All mouse lines were maintained on a mixed genetic background. LooptTle3 line was generated using homologous recombination in ES cells. ES cell injection and chimera generation was performed by the IRCM Transgenesis platform. For transient transgenic lineage tracing, the Hsp68-nLacZ Reporter allele was used. Tle3 null allele was generated by crossing LooptTle3 and CMVCre lines. Pgk-Cre, Mesp1Cre, Mef2cAHFCre, Wnt1Cre, Nkx2.5Cre and R26R lines were previously described elsewhere Ai et al., 2006;Cai et al., 2003;Danielian et al., 1998;Saga et al., 1999;Verzi et al., 2005;Zhang et al., 2013). All mouse lines were maintained on a mixed background. All animal procedures were performed according to the IRCM Animal Care Committee and the Canadian Council on Animal Care.

# Tamoxifen induction of Cre recombinase

For inducible Cre alleles (i.e. Mesp1Cre and Mef2cAHFCre), tamoxifen was dissolved in corn oil by sonication at a concentration of 20mg/ml. Tamoxifen was administrated by oral gavage (1mg) to pregnant females at the indicated time points.

# Immunofluorescence

E9.0 embryos were fixed overnight in 2% PFA at 4°C, and then dehydrated in sucrose gradients.

Embryos were embedded in OCT and cut on a cryostat at 10µm thickness. Immunofluorescence was carried out using standard procedures using the following antibodies: TLE3 (1:100, LifeSpan BioSciences), FOXF1 (1:200), ISL1 (1:100, DSHB), Troponin I (1:100, Santa Cruz), Hand1 (1:100, Santa Cruz), atrial myosin heavy chain (1:50, Abcam) and β myosin heavy chain (1:50, Abcam).

# Histology

For histological analysis, whole embryos (E14.5) or adult hearts were fixed overnight in 4% PFA at 4°C. Embryos and hearts were sectioned at 5µm thickness on a microtome, and sections were mounted and stained according to standard procedures.

# In situ hybridization

Whole mount in situ hybridization was performed according to standard procedures using the following probes: Tle3, Lefty2, Pitx2, myocardin (gift from E. Olson), Irx4 and Fgf8.

# Quantitative real-time PCR

Quantitative real-time PCR (RT-qPCR) was performed on the LpmC and LpmP of control and Wnt1Cre; LooptTle3 embryos. The LpmC and LpmP were microdissected from E9.0 embryos, and total RNA was extracted using the RNeasy® Micro Kit (Qiagen, cat.74004). All cDNA was produced using the QuantiTect® Reverse Transcription Kit (Qiagen, cat.205311). RT-qPCR was performed using an ABI7500 (Applied Biosystems) with Power SYBR® Green (Life Technologies). Gapdh expression was used as the internal control.

For experiments using the Hsp68-nLacZ reporter, hearts were microdissected and dissociated in 0.25% trypsin for 10 minutes at 37°C. Resulting cell suspensions were then equally divided and plated into 96 well plates coated with either fibronectin or matrigel. After 3 hours, whole wells were collected, and total RNA was extracted as mentioned above.

# Electroporations

Transgenic lineage tracing experiments were performed as previously described with a few modifications. Briefly, E8.0 embryos were dissected in sterile PBS and placed in a microelectroporator chamber containing Tyrode's solution. The pCAAGS-nLacZ and pCAGGS-Tle3-IRES-nGFP plasmids were injected into the pericardial cavity with a pressure injector. After 3 pulses of 10V, embryos were cultured in 50% rat serum / 50% Tyrode's solution for 24hrs in a rolling incubator at 37°C, 5% CO2, 95% air.

# Echocardiography

Echocardiography was performed on isoflurane-anesthetized animals using a Vevo660 ultrasound machine (Visualsonics, Toronto, Canada). Measurements of cardiac function were obtained from two-dimensional (short and long axis) images, and M-mode tracings. To evaluate the effect of exercise on heart function, animals were challenged with increasing concentrations of dobutamine (3, 6, 10 and 30µg/g/min), infused over a total period of 15 minutes via the jugular venous catheter inserted at the time of preliminary surgical preparation (typically, 3-4 days before experimental protocol).

# ECG recordings

To measure the functional consequences of structural heart anomalies, three-lead ECG recordings were obtained from anesthetized animals using subcutaneous needle electrodes connected to the temperature-controlled ECG amplifier (AD Instruments). Signal was digitized at the frequency of 10kHz (Powerlab 2/25, AD Instruments) and analyzed using LabChart software (ADInstruments).

# Statistical analysis

All statistical analysis was performed using PRISM software (GraphPad). All pairwise comparisons were made using the student's t-test. Data are presented as mean ± s.e.m., and differences were considered significant with p<0.05.
